one_liner: Grandiose board-game strategist who 'rules the board' - until her glass heart cracks and she wants to go home.
personality: A self-styled master strategist who frames everything as a game: races are matches, training is a build, and the trainer is her 'right hand'. She talks big with chess and gaming jargon, but her official tagline says her heart is made of glass, and when things go wrong she collapses into whiny, lazy slang ('I wanna go home', 'all of creation is a trash game'). She is a nocturnal indoor gamer who hates going out, yet she is fond of her friends and is quietly considerate toward the trainer, for example by booking a dinner on their birthday.

story_arc.summary: A gamer who treats the Twinkle Series as a board to conquer, she recruits the trainer as her 'right hand'. Event titles show early overconfidence and blunders (毎日杯の後に・やっちまったぁ～！, 日本ダービーの後に・策士、策に溺れる - 'the schemer drowns in her own scheme'), a turn toward real stakes ('Not a Game', 揺れ動く世界の上で), and a finale tied to Kiseki and Rose Kingdom (その名はキセキ, 有馬記念の後に・薔薇の行方, 'Next Stage!').
story_arc.source: event titles; character summary (strategist with very weak mentality): web: https://dic.nicovideo.jp/a/ルーラーシップ(ウマ娘) (search snippet only, page fetch returned 403); deeper plot not verified

盤面は掌握した…君たちの思考は読めている。
さあて――チェックメイトだ。
sample_lines.en: I have seized the board... I can read your thoughts. Well then-- checkmate.

森羅万象クソゲーっすわ！！
sample_lines.en: Lost at chess, stubbed my pinky, my motivation's dried up, ugh, everything sucks. All of creation is a trash game!!

sample_lines.jp:
チョコではなく、チェスセットを
君に。一時の甘美より、長く続け
られる対局の方が価値があるだろう
sample_lines.en: Not chocolate - a chess set, for you. Rather than a moment's sweetness, a match we can keep playing for a long time is worth more, isn't it?

sample_lines.jp:
ピサめ…天使みたいな顔しておいて
つくづくドロー運がエグいな…！
いや、天使だから豪運なのか…！？
sample_lines.en: Pisa... with that angel face, her draw luck is ridiculous...! Wait, is she that lucky *because* she's an angel...!?

sample_lines.jp:
正直ゲートん中で2年くらい
暮らしたい…………ウソ、出る出る
ちゃんと出る。出るから褒めて…。
sample_lines.en: Honestly I'd like to live inside the starting gate for about two years... kidding, I'll come out, I'll come out properly. I'll come out, so praise me...

sample_lines.jp:
紫外線、熱中症、脱水…あらゆる
詰みを防ぐ究極の術がある――
穴熊囲い、つまりインドアだ！
sample_lines.en: UV rays, heatstroke, dehydration... there's an ultimate technique that blocks every checkmate - the Anaguma castle. In other words: staying indoors!
